notes.title: One Year Anniversary Update Is Coming! And NEW COLLAB!
notes.notes:
Hey Voyagers,

Sword of Convallaria is officially turning ONE!
We’ve come a long way since launch, and this anniversary update is our way of celebrating with all of you who’ve supported the game from day one.

Anniversary Livestream Recap

[Watch the full livestream replay here]
https://www.youtube.com/live/hJb2TTu-Thk?si=QPIIGhGA6p1Xwc2X

We recently held a special anniversary livestream to look back and look ahead. Here’s a quick recap of what was shared:


 A nostalgic look back on the journey over the past year, including global milestones and community achievements
 Introduction of a powerful new SP version of Inanna. Now joining the roster with new abilities

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/bae1b5f7080eb50253d0642347b29bb141d4214f.jpg

 First look at the upcoming main story update, “For This World of Peace”, and a mysterious new character: Rico

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/ad2a32580972a737a39dfac6552eaa1e08d75e97.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/5407d97fb20a06d5cd9189882c0e9063573918e4.png

 Sneak peek at major system improvements, including tactical optimizations and new progression mechanics
 Full breakdown of anniversary events: free summons, login rewards, new expansion in SoD, new encounter events, and more
 New cosmetics and bundles, including the SP Inanna skin
 A teaser for our upcoming crossover collaboration

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/c07cc0bcbe5adec2b50b55804581e839a3b38c3d.png

Anniversary Roadmap

We’ve also prepared a visual roadmap to help you keep track of everything coming during the anniversary period and what’s just around the corner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/2c5ed853eca5bb946ce5391fd8d8b49ece9dcc12.png

Thank you again for an unforgettable year. Here’s to new adventures and even more stories to uncover in Sword of Convallaria! 

For the complete list of event details, updates, and balance changes, please check the full patch notes attached below.



Full Patch Notes

▼Update Content


1. [Expedition] The brand-new Expedition System is fully implemented.

-  After maintenance on July 30, 2025

-  After maintenance on July 30, 2025 – 20:59, September 25, 2025 (PDT)



19. [Fresh Start Program] New voyager assistance event is now available.

-  After maintenance on July 30, 2025





▼ Optimization Content



1. [Voyage Momento] The difficulty of completing certain quests has been reduced, while the Voyager EXP and rewards such as Radiant Powder have been increased.



2. [Sail On, Voyager!] The Day 6 login reward has been upgraded from Surprise Popper to Random Legendary Tarot Whisper (Series I), while the total quantity of Surprise Popper remains unchanged.



3. [Shop] The double exchange limit for Hope Luxites has been reset.



4. [Crossing Worlds] The "Skip" feature is now available. Voyagers with Voyager Levels 5 levels or higher than the Stage difficulty can consume Endurance to "Skip" battles and receive 3-star clear rewards.



5. [System] A data statistics module has been added to the post-battle results screen. Voyagers can view information such as characters' DMG dealt, healing performed, and HP lost on the respective page. Additionally, cumulative DMG and total healing during battles will now be displayed.



6. [Chat] A new batch of emoji has been added for voyagers to use.



7. [Shop] The display rules for certain bundle tags have been optimized. Apart from tag adjustments, the specific content and pricing of these bundles remain unchanged.



8. [Event] The return event has been optimized. The activation condition has been adjusted from 60 consecutive days of inactivity to 45 days. Certain quest completion difficulties have been reduced, and some event rewards have been consolidated, maintaining the overall reward quantity. These adjustments will take effect after the maintenance on July 30, 2025. For returning players who have already activated the event before the maintenance, the original event content will remain unchanged and can still be completed. Players activating the Returning Player Event after the maintenance will experience the new version's content.



9. [Localization] Support for Spanish, Portuguese, French, and Italian will be added.

- Release Time: 12:00, August 1, 2025 (UTC-4) / 09:00, August 1, 2025 (PDT)





▼ Bug Fixes



1. [Display] Fixed the simplified description of "Block." "[Buff] When hit by physical attack from the front or the side" has been corrected to "When hit by physical attack from the front or the side"



2. [Display] Resolved an issue where Afra would lack movement animations and teleport directly to the target after casting Tread on Snow post-movement.



3. [Display] Optimized the display logic for Tarot Whisper-related information on voyagers' profile.



4. [Inventory] Fixed an issue where the sorting order for batch enhancement of Tarot Whisper was incorrect in certain circumstances.



5. [Spiral of Destinies] Added recommended beacons for "Bustling Shadows" and "Fragile Peace" in the Destiny Route.



6. [Battle] Fixed an issue where "Act Again" would not trigger after activating "Act After Defeat" and defeating an enemy with One-hit Kill.



7. [Battle] Corrected the description of the "Hunt" skill for Elaman Undying Mask Officers to match its actual effect.



8. [Battle] Fixed an abnormal effect issue with the Aura "Noble Vengeance Prayer" for the Iron Thorn Vengeance Priests in certain cases.



9. [Battle] Resolved an issue where the "Tenacious Will" effect was not functioning correctly.



10. [Battle] Fixed an issue where the trinket "Breath-Concealing Ring" had an abnormal cooldown time.



11. [Text] Enhanced the descriptive text for Casting Mold.



12. [Localization] Fixed certain display issues and translation errors.





▼ Maintenance Compensation

Hope Luxites *300 and Endurance Potion (Time-limited) *1 will be distributed via in-game mail as maintenance compensation.

notes.title: July 31 Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hi Voyagers,

Finally, here we are! It has been a while since we teased the release time frame of Sword of Convallaria, today we are finally ready to confirm the official release date. 

Release Date
We are excited to announce that Sword of Convallaria will be released on Steam on July 31, 2024. Thank you all so much for your patience and support throughout this journey. 

Based on your invaluable feedback, we've made significant improvements and refinements to the game. We truly appreciate your dedication and enthusiasm. As we approach the release date, we're eagerly looking forward to hearing your reactions and seeing how you embrace the adventure that awaits in Iria. Remember to mark your calendars for this monumental quest to rescue the nation of Iria!

https://youtu.be/lMO1MHoRX0g
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/1de8ac693accff52eb7caa6edab38baec0346bee.png

More about Sword of Convallaria
We’ll be sharing more details about the release version soon. In the meantime, dive into our previous posts to learn more about the gameplay, story, and characters of Sword of Convallaria:

Sword of Convallaria: Unpacking the Tactical RPG Experience
A Famitsu Interview: Exploring the Essence of Tactical RPGs with Yasumi Matsuno
Unveiling the Mysteries of Iria: Sword of Convallaria's Enigmatic Setting
Town of Convallaria Sneak Peak #1
Town of Convallaria Sneak Peak #2

Meet the Characters

Rawiyah, the Righteous Mercenary
Maitha, The Benevolent Defender
Faycal, The Watchful Archer
Lutfi, The Second-born Prince of Iria
Beryl, The Curious Little Witch of Convallaria


For those eager to be among the first to experience the wonders of Iria, we’ll be hosting a final closed beta test very soon. For more information, check out our official website.

Thank you once again for your unwavering support. We invite you to add Sword of Convallaria to your wishlist to stay updated with the latest news and developments. Your feedback and engagement are crucial to us as we continue to refine and improve the game. Join the conversation on Twitter and Discord to connect with fellow Voyagers, share your thoughts, and stay in the loop with exclusive updates, behind-the-scenes content, and more. We're eager to hear your insights and experiences as we embark on this journey together. 

We can't wait to share more with you soon and build an amazing community around Sword of Convallaria!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/da71346f06b887a3719b983d18a5699a87419c4c.jpg

Special Notice
The demo on our store page will no longer be available when the official release version is live on July 31 PDT.

notes.title: Spring Release in the Works!
notes.notes:
It’s been a wonderful two months since we shared our decision to launch Sword of Convallaria on all major platforms, and we’re overwhelmed by the amazing support from the Steam community and tactical RPG lovers around the world. We went through several rounds of closed betas, sat down with Famitsu and chatted with Yasumi Matsuno, and brought a playable PC demo to Tokyo Game Show 2023. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/ecde3eea3abec37b3bdce5ff0eaefb28485de06a.png

What to expect in the next Spring
While the feedback we've received so far has been incredibly encouraging, there is still a substantial amount of work to be done before we can bring Sword of Convallaria to a global audience. We will concentrate on enhancing gameplay mechanics, optimizing performance, and refining the overall gaming experience as we aim for a release in the upcoming spring. Here's a more detailed look of what we'll be focusing on during this extended development period:

 Enhanced PC experience: refining the user interface for PC, optimizing gameplay controls, and adding controller support, etc. 
 Localization excellence: rectifying improper translations and completing full-game localization for all supported languages to make for an accessible and enjoyable player experience.
 Optimizing the live service plan: We will work on optimizing the structure for the game, which will enable us to provide a consistent flow of fresh content after the game's initial release.
 And more!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/4b0dc9e9a29dde9c33694746f7e1394a0b8de037.png
Here are some early concept art of the church map

Future plans
With the spring release timeline, we should be able to prepare some more exciting content in the pipeline. While we can’t reveal all the details just yet, stay tuned for potential surprises at the Steam Next Fest in 2024!

We’re tremendously grateful for your patience and understanding as we continue to work on Sword of Convallaria and attempt to deliver an authentic tactical RPG experience. We will be sharing more development updates and release info in future posts; please let us know in the comments what some of your favorite tactical RPG elements are and what you’d like to see in Sword of Convallaria at launch.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/f06b77687b4b23ec5c9f7bdbf923404be55d844b.jpg

To keep staying in the loop with Sword of Convallaria, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist! Also, be sure to join the excitement on Twitter and Discord to keep up with the latest buzz!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/da71346f06b887a3719b983d18a5699a87419c4c.jpg
